subject: genetics_genomics

resources.title: NHGRI Educational Resources and Genomics Fact Sheets
resources.notes: Official NHGRI explanations for non-specialists, students and educators. Mapped only to finalized taxonomy keys directly represented by NHGRI educational material. Individual assets retain their own rights and terms.

resources.title: NHGRI Genome Sequencing Program
resources.notes: Official NHGRI program reference for genome sequencing technologies, data resources and use of sequencing to identify disease-associated genes and variants.

resources.title: NCBI Genome and Functional Genomics Resources
resources.notes: NCBI provides Assembly, BioProject, sequence repositories, functional-genomics resources and analysis tools. Dataset-specific access and usage conditions must be retained.

resources.title: NIH Comparative Genomics Resource and NCBI Bioinformatics Tools
resources.notes: Official NIH/NLM resource family including CGR, BLAST, Comparative Genome Viewer, RefSeq and sequence-analysis infrastructure.

resources.title: NCBI Human Genome and Clinical Variation Resources
resources.notes: Official NCBI/NLM human genome resources include ClinVar, dbGaP, dbVar, GTR, BLAST and related variation/clinical-genomics tools. Controlled-access human data must remain restricted.

resources.title: NHGRI Translational and Functional Genomics Branch
resources.notes: Official NHGRI research reference covering genome function, epigenetic mechanisms, computational genomics, functional assessment and translational genomics.

known_gaps: Quantitative genetics still needs stronger dedicated instructional coverage, especially below advanced level.
Population-genetics foundation and beginner instruction remains thinner than general genomics education.
Research databases and controlled human-genomics datasets are not equivalent to locally ingested unrestricted content.
